name: Stepped Out
summary: Tessa asks you to find Gray at Powderfuse Port. He has been away longer than expected, and she wants him home with her and Emma.

sections.title: Tessa's Request
sections.body: Tessa's baby, Emma, is crying as Tessa asks you to look for Gray. He left a while ago and has not come back. She says he often goes to Powderfuse Port, where his bright appearance should make him easy to recognize.

faq.answer: Tessa asks you to find Gray, Emma's father, at Powderfuse Port.

faq.q: Why does Tessa want Gray home?
faq.answer: Tessa says Emma lights up when she sees her father, and she wants to know why he has not come back.

faq.q: Where does Tessa think Gray went?
faq.answer: Tessa says Gray seems to go to Powderfuse Port often.
Tessa says Gray shines as brightly as the sun.
